issues.problem_zh: 题面没说三类错误怎么抛出，参考解答自己也把“分别用三种异常类型还是一种类型加错误码”列为要问面试官的问题；评测需要固定的名字。
issues.change_zh: “可能出现三类错误：”改为“可能出现三类错误，每类抛出一个同名的异常类：”。英文版同样修改。

checked: confirmed the Part 1 example and all six Part 2 examples (three results, three error messages) are asserted by the page's checks and follow from the statement's rules

brute-force compare on 400,000 random signatures and calls against an independent implementation on nested Python tuples (empty tuples, zero-parameter functions, generics not spelled T<digits>, arity changes, mutated arguments): same result, same error class, same ArityError/GenericConflictError message every time
aliasing: the returned tree shares no Node object with the function, the call, or an earlier result, and has no internal sharing; inputs are not mutated
edge cases: () -> int, a generic bound to [], tuple-vs-primitive in both directions raise TypeMismatchError
compared every code fence between README.zh.md and README.md (identical) and read the English prose against the Chinese

code_run.notes: A generic that appears only in the return type (never in a parameter) raises KeyError; the statement does not cover that input, so it was left alone.
